course.title: Scrum Master - Agile Consultant
course.subtitle: Build job-ready skills with expert-led training
roles: Lead daily Stand-up meetings, Sprint planning
Track Project Progress and ensure timely delivery
Manage complete Life cycle of a Software Developement

modules.title: Module 1: Agile Foundations
items: SDLC and the Waterfall model
Agile values and principles, with real-world examples
Agile vs. Waterfall
Benefits of Agile and the projects it suits
Overview of frameworks: Scrum, SAFe, Kanban

modules.title: Module 2: Scrum
items: Scrum theory, pillars and values
Roles: Scrum Master, Product Owner, Developers
Events: Sprint, Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective
Artifacts: Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Increment

Practical topics: Backlog refinement and planning poker, Story slicing and spikes, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, Capacity planning, Scope creep and technical debt, Working with teams across time zones

modules.title: Module 3: SAFe
items: Scrum vs. SAFe, and when to use SAFe
SAFe configurations, values and principles
Roles in SAFe
Agile Release Train (ART) and Scrum of Scrums
PI Planning, plus the PI boards and trackers used (Program Board, Dependency Tracker, Risk Tracker)
Managing dependencies and risks (ROAM)
Inspect & Adapt workshop and System Demo
Value Stream Mapping

modules.title: Module 4: Kanban
items: What Kanban is and where it fits
Scrum vs. SAFe vs. Kanban
Values, principles and suitable projects
WIP limits and the pull system
Flow metrics: Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput

modules.title: Module 5: Agile Metrics and Reporting
items: Scrum : Burndown and Burnup, Velocity, Sprint Churn, Predictability, Defect Ratio
SAFe : PI Predictability, ART Predictability, Program Board and Risk reports
Kanban : Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput, Cumulative Flow Diagram, WIP

modules.title: Module 6: Tools: Jira, Confluence
items: Hands-on Jira and Confluence practice
Dashboards, automation and JQL queries
Jira AI (Rovo) features
Azure DevOps session

modules.title: Module 7: Release Management
items: Role of the Scrum Master in end-to-end releases
Types of releases
Creating fix versions and finalizing stories
Change requests and service overview
